test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who takes a dark view of things
solution:
The correct answer for the one who takes a dark view of things is **Pessimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** Pessimist__ **is a person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __**Additional Information**__

 
• **Pedant**: ​A person who is excessively concerned with minor details and rules or with displaying academic learning.
 
• **Periscope**: An apparatus consisting of a tube attached to a set of mirrors or prisms, by which an observer (typically in a submerged submarine or behind a high obstacle) can see things that are otherwise out of sight.
 
• **Polyglot**: A person who knows and is able to use several languages.
